name: How long does a bathroom remodel usually take?
description: Bathroom remodels typically take 1-6 weeks, depending on complexity, with basic refreshes being shorter and extensive renovations taking longer.

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom remodel depends on its complexity. A basic refresh might take 1-2 weeks. A more extensive renovation involving demolition, new plumbing, electrical work, and custom installations could take 3-6 weeks or even longer. Factors like material availability, permit approvals, and unforeseen issues can also impact the timeline. We will provide a project schedule with clear milestones once the scope is defined.
